thesis: This episode argues that the speaker identifies 'built to last' businesses like Amazon, Berkshire, and Costco as core holdings, while praising Meta's improved capital allocation and viewing Raysas as a simple, well-run family business. Conversely, the speaker expresses a neutral stance on Tesla, noting that analyzing such a complex business is 'too hard' and that Elon Musk is 'beyond human.'
